mapper.select: select a.ID as id,a.TENANT_ID as tenantId,a.USER_ID as userId,a.SHARE_TIME as shareTime,a.END_TIME as endTime,a.EXTRACTION_CODE as extractionCode, a.SHARE_BATCH_NUM as shareBatchNum,a.SHARE_TYPE as shareType,a.SHARE_STATUS as shareStatus, b.ID as shareFileId,b.USER_FILE_ID as userFileId,b.SHARE_FILE_PATH as shareFilePath, c.PARENT_ID as parentId,c.FILE_NAME as fileName,c.FILE_PATH as filePath,c.IS_DIR as isDir,c.FILE_ID as fileId,c.DELETE_FLAG as deleteFlag, c.ROOT_DIR as rootDir,c.`RIGHT` as `right`,c.ORG_ID as orgId,c.DATA_SCOPE_ID as dataScopeId,c.LOCK_FLAG as lockFlag, c.FOLD_TYPE as foldType,c.EXTEND_NAME as extendName, d.FILE_SIZE as fileSize,d.SUFFIX as suffix,d.FILE_STATUS as fileStatus,d.FILE_URL as fileUrl,d.IDENTIFIER as identifier, d.STORAGE_TYPE as storageType,d.EXT_JSON as extJson from PAN_SHARE a left join PAN_SHARE_FILE b on a.SHARE_BATCH_NUM = b.SHARE_BATCH_NUM and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' left join PAN_USER_FILE c on b.USER_FILE_ID = c.ID and c.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' left join PAN_FILE d on c.FILE_ID = d.ID and d.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ${ew.customSqlSegment}
